title.zh: CCW日內瓦大會11/20落幕：各國只同意「繼續討論」到2028、未啟動具法律約束力的自主武器談判，美俄以色列聯手擋下、正面驗證11/9週報「不可查證」的核心判斷；法國外長11/9在G7部長會議正式將10月逾700處商用冷凍系統破壞性入侵歸咎伊斯蘭革命衛隊「Shahid Kaveh」單位、開啟司法調查並揚言EU制裁，但11/2另一波波及9國逾百家商店的攻擊至今仍未破案；Huntress揭露蠕蟲式SCKit工具組90分鐘內攻陷288台ScreenConnect端點、橫跨48家企業；BIS遠端存取規則細節補完——正式廢止拜登時代AI Diffusion Rule，中國截至查核時點仍無具體反制行動；Counterpoint Research：Q3記憶體產業營收年增近5倍，三星SK海力士2026年產能近乎售罄
title.en: CCW's Geneva Review Conference Closes 11/20 With States Agreeing Only to 'Keep Discussing' Autonomous Weapons Through 2028, No Legally Binding Negotiations Launched, as the US, Russia and Israel Block a Mandate — Directly Confirming the 11/9 Weekly's 'Dies of Unverifiability' Thesis; France's Foreign Minister Formally Attributes October's Destructive Intrusion Into 700+ Commercial Refrigeration Systems to IRGC's 'Shahid Kaveh' Unit at a 11/9 G7 Ministerial, Opening a Judicial Probe and Threatening EU Sanctions — Though a Separate 11/2 Wave Hitting 100+ Stores Across 9 Countries Remains Unattributed; Huntress Exposes the Worm-Like SCKit Toolkit Compromising 288 ScreenConnect Endpoints Across 48 Organizations Within 90 Minutes; BIS's Remote Access Rule Gets Fleshed Out — Formally Rescinding the Biden-Era AI Diffusion Rule, With China Still Taking No Concrete Retaliatory Action as of This Check; Counterpoint Research Puts Q3 Memory-Industry Revenue Up Nearly 5x YoY as Samsung and SK Hynix's 2026 Capacity Runs Nearly Sold Out

focus.zh: 本期6條。最重要的一條是終局性的：CCW《特定常規武器公約》第七次審查大會11/16-20在日內瓦登場，這正是11/9週報與11/16報告持續追蹤的那場大會。結果多方媒體（經AP通訊社稿轉述）一致確認：與會國只同意「繼續討論」並以2028年為目標「精緻化」一份可能的協議，沒有啟動任何具法律約束力的談判授權，美國、俄羅斯與以色列是主要反對方，七個國家原本提出的談判授權提案最終落空，ICRC公開表達遺憾。這不是過程性的「草案被稀釋」，而是本站追蹤超過一年的這條敘事線第一次走到終局——11/9週報當時的判斷「LAWS軍控真正的死因是不可查證」本期獲得了最硬的驗證：不是查證機制沒寫進草案，是連草案本身、連帶整個談判程序都沒有被啟動。同一時間軸上，法國外交部長Barrot 11/9在G7部長會議公開將10月那起造成法國逾700個商用冷凍控制系統過熱起火的破壞性入侵，正式歸咎伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)旗下「Shahid Kaveh」單位——這是10/14報告與11/12報告追蹤的冷鏈入侵事件系列中，第一次有國家層級的正式歸因、外交召見與司法調查，但本期查核也補上一個先前未被本站記錄的細節：11/2另有一波波及比利時、愛沙尼亞、芬蘭、愛爾蘭、義大利、盧森堡、荷蘭、葡萄牙、瑞典等至少9國的商用冷凍系統攻擊，受害連鎖品牌(Delhaize、Carrefour、Coop、ICA、IKEA、Kesko等)與10月法國案不同，查核範圍內沒有找到任何一方確認兩波攻擊屬於同一行為者。資安端，Huntress揭露一套名為SCKit的蠕蟲式工具組，2026年11月在90分鐘內攻陷288台橫跨48家企業的ScreenConnect端點、其中三分之一在前10分鐘內就已淪陷，ConnectWise已停用5個相關第三方擴充套件、影響約400個合作夥伴環境。政策端，本期查核補完11/20報告記錄的BIS「遠端存取規則」細節：這份規則同時正式廢止了拜登時代的AI Diffusion Rule，新的「遠端存取」終端用途管制已寫入EAR § 744.24，而國會另有一條跑了快一年的平行legislative管道——Remote Access Security Act(H.R.2683/S.3519)，眾院已於今年1月以369比22票通過、參院審議中——截至本次查核，中國商務部仍只有11/17的口頭反制揚言，沒有任何具體反制行動落地。技術前沿端，Counterpoint Research的Q3 2026資料顯示記憶體產業營收年增近5倍、三星以38%市佔居冠(SK海力士29%、Micron 21%、CXMT 9%)，SK海力士單季營收季增逾40%，三大廠2026全年HBM與DRAM產能已近乎售罄，Counterpoint預期2027年價格續漲，因新產能要到2028年才能量產。本期查核持續受雲端環境出網白名單限制，CCW官方會議記錄、聯邦公報原文、BIS原始新聞稿、法國外交部與Huntress原始部落格均無法直接存取，只能依賴WebSearch摘要與多方媒體交叉比對，本期因此沒有任何一條給到confirmed等級，全部標為likely，已在各條中如實標註。
focus.en: 6 items this period. The most consequential one is a terminal outcome: the CCW's Seventh Review Conference on the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons ran 11/16-20 in Geneva — exactly the conference the 11/9 weekly and 11/16 report had been tracking. Multiple outlets (via AP wire relays) consistently confirm the result: states agreed only to keep discussing and 'elaborate' a possible accord by 2028, with no legally binding negotiating mandate launched; the US, Russia and Israel were the principal opponents, the seven-country proposal to open formal negotiations fell short, and the ICRC publicly voiced regret. This isn't another process story about a draft being watered down — it's the first time in over a year of this site's tracking that the thread reached a terminal point: the 11/9 weekly's judgment that 'LAWS arms control dies of unverifiability' gets its hardest confirmation yet — not because a verification mechanism was left out of the draft, but because neither the draft nor the negotiating process itself was ever launched. On the same timeline, French Foreign Minister Barrot publicly attributed October's destructive intrusion into 700+ French commercial refrigeration control systems — which caused overheating and fires — to Iran's IRGC-linked 'Shahid Kaveh' unit at a 11/9 G7 ministerial, the first state-level formal attribution, ambassadorial summons and judicial probe in the cold-chain intrusion series the 10/14 and 11/12 reports have tracked. This check also fills in a detail this site had not previously logged: a separate 11/2 wave hit commercial refrigeration systems across at least 9 countries — Belgium, Estonia, Finland, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal and Sweden — at different retail chains (Delhaize, Carrefour, Coop, ICA, IKEA, Kesko and others) than October's French case, and this check found no party confirming the two waves share an actor. On cyber, Huntress exposed a worm-like toolkit named SCKit that compromised 288 ScreenConnect endpoints across 48 organizations within 90 minutes in November 2026, a third of them within the first 10 minutes; ConnectWise has disabled five related third-party extensions affecting roughly 400 partner environments. On policy, this check fills in detail on the BIS 'Remote Access Rule' the 11/20 report logged: the same rule formally rescinds the Biden-era AI Diffusion Rule, writes the new remote-access end-use control into EAR § 744.24, and runs alongside a nearly year-old parallel legislative track — the Remote Access Security Act (H.R.2683/S.3519), which passed the House 369-22 in January and remains pending in the Senate — while China's Commerce Ministry, as of this check, has issued only its 11/17 verbal threat with no concrete retaliatory action taken. On frontier tech, Counterpoint Research's Q3 2026 data shows memory-industry revenue up nearly 5x year-over-year, with Samsung leading at 38% share (SK Hynix 29%, Micron 21%, CXMT 9%), SK Hynix's quarterly revenue up over 40% QoQ, and all three majors' 2026 HBM and DRAM capacity running nearly sold out; Counterpoint expects prices to keep rising into 2027 since new capacity won't come online until 2028. This check remains constrained by the cloud environment's outbound network allowlist: the CCW's own meeting records, the Federal Register text, BIS's original press release, and the French foreign ministry's and Huntress's own pages were all unreachable directly, leaving this check to rely on WebSearch summaries cross-checked across multiple outlets — no item this period reaches 'confirmed,' and all are honestly marked likely.

title.zh: CCW第七次審查大會11/20在日內瓦落幕：各國只同意「繼續討論」、以2028年為目標「精緻化」協議，美俄以色列聯手擋下具法律約束力的談判授權——11/9週報「LAWS死於不可查證」的核心判斷本期走到終局性驗證
title.en: CCW's Seventh Review Conference Closes 11/20 in Geneva: States Agree Only to 'Keep Discussing,' Targeting an 'Elaborated' Accord by 2028, as the US, Russia and Israel Block a Legally Binding Mandate — the 11/9 Weekly's 'LAWS Dies of Unverifiability' Thesis Reaches a Terminal Confirmation

summary.zh: 11/16-20在日內瓦召開的這場為期一週的CCW審查大會，正是11/16報告記錄「兩份競爭中的談判授權草案都沒寫查證機制」的同一場會議。查核時點（11/21）多家媒體（經美聯社通訊社稿、由WDBO、KIRO 7、Click2Houston等地方台轉載，另有The Globe and Mail、swissinfo.ch獨立報導）一致確認：與會國最終只同意「繼續討論」自主武器系統，目標是在2028年前「精緻化」一份可能的協議文本，但沒有對聯合國秘書長古特雷斯與多數與會國要求的具法律約束力規則做出承諾。由於CCW採共識決，任何一國都能否決，美國、俄羅斯與以色列是本期查核能確認名字的主要反對方；會前七國原本聯合提出啟動正式談判的授權草案，最終沒有被採納。國際紅十字會(ICRC)公開表示對此結果遺憾，重申對具約束力條約的呼籲。
summary.en: The week-long CCW Review Conference ran 11/16-20 in Geneva — the same conference the 11/16 report logged as having 'two competing mandate drafts, neither including a verification mechanism.' As of this check (11/21), multiple outlets (an AP wire story relayed by WDBO, KIRO 7 and Click2Houston, plus independent coverage from The Globe and Mail and swissinfo.ch) consistently confirm: states ultimately agreed only to keep discussing autonomous weapons systems, aiming to 'elaborate' a possible accord by 2028, without committing to the legally binding rules UN Secretary-General Guterres and most attending states had sought. Because the CCW operates by consensus, any single state can block an outcome; the US, Russia and Israel are the opponents this check could confirm by name. A pre-conference proposal from seven states to open formal negotiations was not adopted. The ICRC publicly expressed regret over the outcome and renewed its call for a binding treaty.

implication.zh: 11/9週報當時把「不可查證」定性為LAWS軍控真正的死因，而不是任何單一國家的政治意願問題；11/16報告進一步記錄兩份草案都刻意迴避查證機制文字。本期的大會結果把這條線索從「過程中被稀釋」直接推進到「整個程序本身都沒有被啟動」——這是比任何一份被稀釋的草案都更乾淨的驗證：不需要爭論某個條文寫得夠不夠嚴謹，因為連談判本身都沒有獲得授權。對你跟各國高階官員對談的操作意義：這代表至少到2028年為止，任何涉及自主武器系統的國際規範都不會以「具法律約束力的公約」形式存在，實際的行為規則會持續由各國自己的採購規格、交戰規則與軟體授權條款(例如DoDD 3000.09這類單邊政策文件)分別書寫——這正是11/9週報當時給出的操作性結論，本期大會結果等於是把這個結論從「預測」升格為「已發生的事實」。對威脅獵攻研究而言，這也代表「自主武器的國際問責空窗期」至少還有兩年以上的確定期限，可以直接寫進任何關於AI軍事化的風險模型假設裡。
implication.en: The 11/9 weekly characterized unverifiability as LAWS arms control's real cause of death, not any single state's political will; the 11/16 report further logged that both competing drafts deliberately avoided verification-mechanism language. This period's conference outcome pushes that thread from 'watered down mid-process' straight to 'the process itself was never launched' — a cleaner confirmation than any diluted draft could offer, since there's no need to argue over whether some clause was rigorous enough when the negotiation itself was never authorized. The operationally useful takeaway for a senior conversation: at least through 2028, no international norm governing autonomous weapons systems will exist in the form of a legally binding convention — the actual rules of behavior will keep being written separately, in each state's own procurement specs, rules of engagement and software licensing terms (unilateral policy documents like DoDD 3000.09). That is exactly the operational conclusion the 11/9 weekly drew at the time; this period's conference result upgrades that conclusion from a forecast to an observed fact. For threat-hunting research, this also means the accountability gap for autonomous weapons has a confirmed floor of at least two more years — something that can be written directly into any AI-militarization risk model's assumptions.

counterpoint.zh: 三點保留。第一，查核範圍內未能直接讀取CCW官方會議記錄或最終文件原文，所有細節均來自美聯社通訊社稿的二手轉載與swissinfo.ch等獨立報導，不排除正式文件使用的措辭比「繼續討論」更具體、留有尚未被媒體充分報導的程序性進展。第二，「美俄以色列聯手擋下」這個三國清單，部分早期搜尋結果曾提到印度也在反對陣營，但僅單一來源、未經交叉確認，本條保守只列入三方媒體一致確認的美俄以。第三，「2028年為目標精緻化協議」本身仍是一個開放式承諾，不排除屆時又出現新一輪的草案稀釋，不應把這次結果直接等同於「國際社會徹底放棄」，正確的說法是「至少到2028年前，正式的具法律約束力談判不會開始」，而非「永遠不會開始」。
counterpoint.en: Three caveats. First, this check could not directly read the CCW's own meeting records or final document text; all detail comes from secondary relays of an AP wire story and independent coverage like swissinfo.ch, so the formal text may use more specific language than 'keep discussing' with procedural progress not yet fully reported by media. Second, on the 'US, Russia and Israel' bloc — some early search results mentioned India also opposing, but only from a single uncorroborated source, so this item conservatively lists only the three states multiple outlets confirmed. Third, the 'elaborate an accord by 2028' commitment remains open-ended; a further round of dilution by then can't be ruled out, and this result should not be read as 'the international community has permanently given up' — the defensible claim is only that formal, legally binding negotiations will not begin before 2028, not that they never will.

items.source: 美聯社通訊社稿（經WDBO、KIRO 7、Click2Houston、The Globe and Mail、swissinfo.ch等轉述）；ICRC聲明

title.zh: 法國外長11/9在G7部長會議正式將10月法國逾700處商用冷凍系統破壞性入侵歸咎IRGC「Shahid Kaveh」單位、召見伊朗大使並開啟司法調查；查核另補上11/2一波波及9國逾百家商店的攻擊，至今仍未破案、未確認與法國案同一行為者
title.en: France's FM Formally Attributes October's Destructive Intrusion Into 700+ Commercial Refrigeration Systems to IRGC's 'Shahid Kaveh' Unit at a 11/9 G7 Ministerial, Summoning Iran's Ambassador and Opening a Judicial Probe — This Check Also Surfaces a Separate 11/2 Wave Hitting 100+ Stores Across 9 Countries, Still Unsolved and Not Confirmed as the Same Actor

summary.zh: 10/14報告記錄過法國近200家超市冷凍系統10/11-12遭入侵、冰箱溫度被改到約50°C引發起火的事件，當時無人出面承認；11/12報告記錄CISA等五機關11/5首度就工業冷鏈控制系統發出聯合警示。本期查核發現：法國外交部長Jean-Noël Barrot 11/9在巴黎G7部長會議上公開表態，確認這起攻擊是伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)旗下「Shahid Kaveh」單位所為，形容其規模與攻擊性「史無前例」；法國數據顯示受害範圍已擴大到約700個據點、至少15起火災，法國網路危機協調中心(C4)將攻擊時間點定在10/11-12夜間；歸因依據包括入侵手法與Shahid Kaveh過往案例相符、攻擊基礎設施中發現波斯文痕跡與伊朗IP、以及可追溯至2024年6月的偵察活動。法國隨即召見伊朗大使、巴黎檢察官Laure Beccuau對該單位首腦與兩名副手展開司法調查，法國並表示將提案新一輪EU制裁；德黑蘭否認涉案、拒絕承認與Shahid Kaveh的關聯。查核同時發現一條此前未被本站記錄的平行事件：11/2另有一波攻擊波及比利時、愛沙尼亞、芬蘭、愛爾蘭、義大利、盧森堡、荷蘭、葡萄牙、瑞典等至少9國的商用冷凍系統，手法同樣是遠端把蒸發器切到除霜模式、推高溫度，受害品牌包括Delhaize、Carrefour、Coop(瑞典ICA)與IKEA比利時門市等，與法國案不同廠牌、不同國家；瑞典NCSC表示正在監控，查核範圍內沒有任何機構將這波攻擊與法國案或IRGC做出正式連結。
summary.en: The 10/14 report logged the 10/11-12 intrusion into nearly 200 French supermarkets' refrigeration systems that pushed temperatures to roughly 50°C and sparked fires, unclaimed at the time; the 11/12 report logged CISA and four other agencies' first joint warning on industrial cold-chain control systems on 11/5. This check finds: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot publicly stated at a G7 ministerial in Paris on 11/9 that the intrusion was the work of IRGC-linked unit 'Shahid Kaveh,' calling its scale and aggressiveness unprecedented; French data now puts the affected site count at roughly 700, with at least 15 fires, and France's Cyber Crisis Coordination Centre (C4) dates the intrusion to overnight 10/11-12. The attribution rests on intrusion patterns matching prior Shahid Kaveh activity, Farsi-language traces and Iranian IPs found in the attack infrastructure, and reconnaissance tracing back to June 2024. France summoned Iran's ambassador, Paris prosecutor Laure Beccuau opened a judicial investigation into the unit's head and two deputies, and France said it would propose a new round of EU sanctions; Tehran denies involvement and rejects any link to Shahid Kaveh. This check separately surfaces a parallel event this site had not previously logged: a separate 11/2 wave hit commercial refrigeration systems across at least 9 countries — Belgium, Estonia, Finland, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal and Sweden — using the same method of remotely switching evaporators into defrost mode to raise temperatures, hitting different brands (Delhaize, Carrefour, Coop/ICA in Sweden, an IKEA store in Belgium) in different countries than the French case. Sweden's NCSC says it is monitoring, and this check found no institution formally linking this wave to the French case or to IRGC.

implication.zh: 這是10/14報告留下的「無人認領」懸案，第一次有國家層級的正式歸因、外交行動與司法程序接上——從「技術性入侵、原因不明」升級為「伊朗對歐洲關鍵基礎設施的國家級破壞行動」，而且是在伊朗戰事仍在進行的背景下發生，等於把本站長期追蹤的伊朗戰場，實質外溢到歐洲本土的糧食冷鏈這個此前被視為「軍事行動範圍之外」的領域。對你的威脅獵捕與地緣研究方法而言，更值得注意的是查核過程中浮現的這個方法論陷阱：11/2發生在法國案與G7歸因之間的第二波攻擊，手法高度相似、卻發生在完全不同的國家與品牌組合，如果只看「手法相似」就把兩波攻擊合併成同一條敘事，會製造出一個查核範圍內任何一方都沒有做出的歸因連結；反過來，如果忽略第二波的存在，又會低估這整個攻擊面(暴露在公網上、使用可預測預設密碼的工業冷凍控制器)已經被至少兩個、而非一個行為者發現並利用的事實。對你跟各國官員對談時，這兩件事應該分開陳述：「伊朗對法國的破壞性行動已經有正式國家歸因」是一句話，「這類冷凍系統漏洞本身已經被證明可以被多方複製利用，攻擊者不必然是同一方」是另一句話，混在一起會讓你在被追問「所以11/2那波也是伊朗做的嗎」時站不住腳。
implication.en: This is the first time the unclaimed case the 10/14 report left open has connected to a state-level formal attribution, diplomatic action and judicial process — upgrading it from 'an unexplained technical intrusion' to 'a state-level Iranian sabotage operation against European critical infrastructure,' occurring against the backdrop of an Iran war this site has tracked for months, effectively spilling that conflict into Europe's own food cold chain — a domain previously treated as outside the war's scope. More worth flagging for your own threat-hunting and geopolitical method is a methodological trap that surfaced during this check: the 11/2 second wave, which fell between the French case and the G7 attribution, used a highly similar method but hit an entirely different combination of countries and brands. Merging the two waves into one narrative purely because the method looks similar would manufacture an attribution link that no party in this check's reach has actually made; conversely, ignoring the second wave's existence would understate how this entire attack surface — internet-exposed industrial refrigeration controllers running predictable default passwords — has now been found and exploited by at least two actors, not necessarily one. In a senior conversation, these should be stated separately: 'Iran's sabotage against France now has formal state attribution' is one sentence; 'this class of refrigeration-system flaw has itself been shown to be independently exploitable by multiple parties, not necessarily the same one' is another — conflating them is exactly what collapses under the follow-up question 'so was the 11/2 wave Iran too?'

counterpoint.zh: 兩點保留。第一，法國的歸因是政府自身的評估，不是法院判決，查核範圍內未能直接讀取法國外交部或C4的官方公告原文，所有細節均來自BleepingComputer、The Record、Khaleej Times等媒體對Barrot發言與法國官員簡報的轉述，不排除細節與原始文件有出入，德黑蘭的否認本身也還沒有被任何獨立第三方技術報告反駁或證實。第二，11/2那波攻擊目前連「是否為同一手法的技術細節」都只來自零星的國別媒體報導(Infosecurity Magazine、Sabcobel公司聲明等)，查核範圍內最大的不確定性在於：這究竟是一次獨立的犯罪集團模仿攻擊(利用同一類已知暴露的Danfoss/Copeland控制器漏洞)、還是Shahid Kaveh自己在歸因公開前後刻意擴大行動範圍，兩種情境對你的風險定價意義完全不同，但查核範圍內沒有任何一方給出能解決這個問題的證據。
counterpoint.en: Two caveats. First, France's attribution is its own government assessment, not a court ruling; this check could not read the French foreign ministry's or C4's own notice directly, and all detail comes from media relays (BleepingComputer, The Record, Khaleej Times) of Barrot's remarks and official briefings, so details could diverge from the primary document, and Tehran's denial itself has neither been independently rebutted nor confirmed by any third-party technical report. Second, even the basic claim that the 11/2 wave used the same technical method currently traces only to scattered national media (Infosecurity Magazine, a Sabcobel company statement); the biggest uncertainty this check found is whether this was an independent criminal group copying a known exploitable flaw class in Danfoss/Copeland controllers, or Shahid Kaveh itself deliberately widening its operations around the time of attribution — two scenarios with very different risk-pricing implications, and this check found no evidence from any party that settles which it is.

items.source: 法國外交部長Jean-Noël Barrot（經BleepingComputer、The Record、Khaleej Times、Tribune等轉述）；Infosecurity Magazine、Sabcobel公司聲明

title.zh: Huntress揭露蠕蟲式SCKit工具組：90分鐘內攻陷橫跨48家企業的288台ScreenConnect端點、三分之一在前10分鐘內淪陷，ConnectWise停用5個第三方擴充套件、波及約400個合作夥伴環境
title.en: Huntress Exposes Worm-Like SCKit Toolkit: 288 ScreenConnect Endpoints Across 48 Organizations Compromised in 90 Minutes, a Third Within the First 10 — ConnectWise Disables Five Third-Party Extensions Across ~400 Partner Environments

summary.zh: 資安廠商Huntress 11/11首度發現一波針對ScreenConnect的攻擊活動，攻擊者利用雲端代管的ScreenConnect主控台執行指令，植入未經授權的ScreenConnect客戶端與一套Huntress命名為SCKit的工具組。隨查核推進、數字持續上修：BleepingComputer早期報導6家MSP、286個端點、47個組織受害，The Hacker News與Huntress最新統計則是至少288個端點、橫跨48個組織，且全數288個已知端點在90分鐘內就已淪陷，其中約三分之一在最初10分鐘內就被攻陷，顯示高度自動化的蠕蟲式擴散速度。目前查核範圍內把入侵路徑指向RMM+擴充套件1.0.31與1.0.32版本的身分驗證缺陷，但這點尚未獲得獨立來源確認。ConnectWise已回應停用5個相關第三方擴充套件，影響約400個合作夥伴環境(並非全部400個環境都已確認遭入侵)；Huntress與ConnectWise同時提醒，停用擴充套件與重設憑證未必能清除攻擊者已經在端點上建立的既有存取權限，調查時也不應透過ScreenConnect本身連線排查。查核範圍內尚未有任何攻擊者歸因。
summary.en: Security vendor Huntress first spotted a ScreenConnect-targeting campaign on 11/11, with attackers using cloud-hosted ScreenConnect consoles to run commands that installed unauthorized ScreenConnect clients and a toolkit Huntress named SCKit. The numbers have climbed as the check progressed: BleepingComputer's early reporting put it at 6 MSPs, 286 endpoints and 47 organizations; The Hacker News's and Huntress's latest count is at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations, with all 288 known endpoints compromised within 90 minutes — roughly a third within the first 10 minutes — indicating a highly automated, worm-like spread rate. This check's reach points to an authentication flaw in RMM+ extension versions 1.0.31 and 1.0.32 as the likely entry point, though this remains unconfirmed by an independent source. ConnectWise has responded by disabling five related third-party extensions, affecting roughly 400 partner environments (not all 400 are confirmed compromised); Huntress and ConnectWise both caution that disabling extensions and resetting credentials may not remove access attackers have already established on endpoints, and advise against investigating through ScreenConnect itself. No attacker attribution has emerged within this check's reach.

implication.zh: 本站10/24報告與11/18報告已經兩次記錄過Storm-0940經由ARTEX打穿ConnectWise供應鏈、鎖定逾2,250個M365租戶的案例；這次SCKit事件雖然同樣以ConnectWise生態系為受害面，但入侵向量(RMM+擴充套件身分驗證缺陷)與前兩次不同，代表ConnectWise這個節點正在被至少兩組不同的攻擊手法反覆命中——對MSP供應鏈的風險評估而言，這意味著「修補了ARTEX相關的漏洞」不等於「這個供應鏈節點安全了」，每一次針對同一個熱門RMM平台的獨立入侵事件，都應該被當成對整個MSP生態系統暴露面的新一次壓力測試，而不是同一個故事的重複。90分鐘內攻陷288個端點、三分之一在10分鐘內淪陷，這個速度本身比任何歸因都更值得你記住：這已經是自動化腳本等級的攻陷速度，留給防禦方的偵測與圍堵窗口被壓縮到接近即時，任何依賴「人工覆核警報」的SOC流程在這類攻擊面前基本上形同虛設。
implication.en: This site's 10/24 and 11/18 reports already logged, twice, Storm-0940 using ARTEX to breach ConnectWise's supply chain and target 2,250+ M365 tenants. This SCKit incident hits the same ConnectWise ecosystem but through a different vector (an RMM+ extension authentication flaw), meaning this node is being hit repeatedly by at least two distinct attack methods — for MSP supply-chain risk assessment, this means patching the ARTEX-related flaw does not equal this supply-chain node being secure; each independent intrusion against the same popular RMM platform should be treated as a fresh stress test of the whole MSP ecosystem's exposure surface, not a repeat of the same story. The speed itself — 288 endpoints in 90 minutes, a third within 10 — is more worth remembering than any attribution: this is already automation-script-grade compromise speed, compressing the defender's detection-and-containment window to near-real-time, and any SOC process relying on manual alert triage is effectively obsolete against this class of attack.

title.zh: BIS遠端存取規則細節補完：11/16同步正式廢止拜登時代AI Diffusion Rule、新端用途管制寫入EAR § 744.24；國會平行法案RASA眾院369比22通過已近一年、參院仍未表決；中國截至查核時點仍只有口頭揚言、無具體反制
title.en: BIS Remote Access Rule Details Fill In: 11/16 Rule Also Formally Rescinds the Biden-Era AI Diffusion Rule, Writes the New End-Use Control Into EAR § 744.24; Congress's Parallel RASA Bill, Passed 369-22 in the House Nearly a Year Ago, Still Awaits Senate Action; China Still Only Verbally Threatens Retaliation as of This Check

summary.zh: 11/20報告已記錄BIS於11/16發布「遠端存取」臨時最終規則、中國商務部11/17揚言反制。本期查核透過多家法律事務所(Gibson Dunn、WilmerHale、Morgan Lewis、Wiley、Squire Patton Boggs、Pillsbury等)對規則文本的交叉解讀補上細節：這份規則同時正式廢止了拜登政府任內制定的「AI Diffusion Rule」(原本將各國分為三級、據此限制AI晶片出口與資料中心授權的框架)，新的「遠端存取」終端用途管制被寫入出口管理條例(EAR)第744.24節，管制對象是全球範圍內(不限於原先點名的馬來西亞、新加坡、印尼、泰國、巴西)、匯總運算力超過門檻的資料中心，公眾意見徵詢期訂在2027/1/18截止。與此同時，國會另有一條跑了近一年的平行legislative管道：參議員McCormick與Wyden 2025/12/17提出的「遠端存取安全法案」(Remote Access Security Act, RASA, H.R.2683/S.3519)，旨在把BIS規範「遠端存取」本身的權限明文授權化，眾議院已於2026/1/12以369比22的壓倒性跨黨派票數通過，但查核時點參議院尚未表決，可能併入年度國防授權法案(NDAA)等「必過法案」裡推進。中國商務部方面，截至本次查核沒有找到任何具體反制措施(新清單、關稅、實體清單)落地的證據，仍停留在11/17的口頭聲明階段。
summary.en: The 11/20 report already logged BIS issuing its 'remote access' interim final rule on 11/16 and China's Commerce Ministry threatening countermeasures on 11/17. This check fills in detail via cross-readings of the rule text from multiple law firms (Gibson Dunn, WilmerHale, Morgan Lewis, Wiley, Squire Patton Boggs, Pillsbury): the same rule formally rescinds the Biden-era 'AI Diffusion Rule' (the framework sorting countries into three tiers to restrict AI-chip exports and data-center authorizations), with the new remote-access end-use control written into EAR § 744.24, covering data centers worldwide (not limited to the originally named Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil) whose aggregate compute exceeds a threshold; the public comment period runs through 2027-01-18. Meanwhile, Congress has a parallel legislative track nearly a year in motion: Senators McCormick and Wyden's Remote Access Security Act (RASA, H.R.2683/S.3519), introduced 2025-12-17, which would expressly authorize BIS to regulate remote access itself, passed the House 369-22 on 2026-01-12 in an overwhelming bipartisan vote, but remains unvoted in the Senate as of this check, possibly advancing via a must-pass vehicle like the annual NDAA. On China's side, this check found no evidence of any concrete retaliatory action (a new list, tariffs, an entity designation) having materialized, with Beijing's Commerce Ministry still at the stage of its 11/17 verbal statement.

implication.zh: 11/20報告當時把這份規則定性為「美方首度把管制範圍從晶片出口延伸到運算力的遠端取用」，本期補上的細節讓這個判斷更精確：這不是一份孤立的行政命令，而是取代了一整套三級國別框架的新體制，而且國會那條平行立法早在去年12月就已經啟動、眾院也已表決近一年——代表「把遠端存取本身納入出口管制」這件事，在華府內部其實醞釀了遠比11/16這個公告日期更長的時間，只是行政部門(BIS)用臨時最終規則的方式先一步落地，國會的永久立法授權還在後面排隊。對你評估美中科技管制的持久性而言，這代表這項管制的政治基礎相對紮實(跨黨派、歷時近一年)，不太可能因為行政團隊更替而輕易撤回；而中國商務部至今沒有具體反制這件事本身，也是一個值得記住的資料點——11/20報告的counterpoint當時就誠實標註「揚言≠已反制」，本期查核把這個「未解決」狀態坐實到11/21這個時間點，意味著從11/17到查核時點已經過了至少4天，中方選擇不急於對等反制，這和過去稀土管制、Affiliates Rule等議題上中方「對等反制」的既有模式有落差，是否代表北京這次評估「這條管制的實質損害不足以升級對應」，值得後續追蹤。
implication.en: The 11/20 report characterized this rule as Washington's first extension of controls from chip exports to remote access to compute itself; the detail this check fills in sharpens that judgment: this isn't a standalone executive action but a new regime replacing an entire three-tier country framework, and Congress's parallel legislation was already in motion since last December, with the House vote nearly a year old — meaning bringing remote access itself under export control had actually been brewing in Washington for far longer than the 11/16 announcement date suggests; the executive branch (BIS) simply got there first via an interim final rule, with Congress's permanent legislative authorization still in the queue behind it. For assessing how durable this US-China tech control is, this means its political foundation is relatively solid (bipartisan, nearly a year in the making), making it unlikely to be easily reversed by an administration change. China's Commerce Ministry still taking no concrete retaliatory action is itself a data point worth keeping: the 11/20 report's counterpoint honestly flagged 'threatened ≠ retaliated' at the time; this check cements that 'unresolved' status through 11/21 — at least 4 days after the 11/17 statement — meaning Beijing is choosing not to rush a reciprocal response, a departure from its own past pattern on rare-earth controls and the Affiliates Rule of matching countermeasures. Whether this reflects Beijing judging this particular rule's real damage as not worth escalating over is worth tracking going forward.

counterpoint.zh: 兩點保留。第一，「正式廢止AI Diffusion Rule」與「新管制寫入EAR § 744.24」的細節，全數來自法律事務所對規則文本的二手解讀，查核範圍內未能直接讀取聯邦公報原文逐條核對，不同事務所對生效日期(11/15或11/16)、公眾意見徵詢截止日的描述也有輕微出入，不排除正式文件與這些解讀存在細節落差。第二，國會RASA法案「跑了近一年」這個時間軸本身無助於預測它何時會通過參院、是否真的會被納入NDAA，查核範圍內沒有找到參院審議進度的具體時間表，不應把「眾院早已通過」解讀為「參院通過只是時間問題」，美國國會近年不乏跨黨派眾院法案最終卡在參院多年未表決的前例。
counterpoint.en: Two caveats. First, the detail on the AI Diffusion Rule's formal rescission and the new control's placement in EAR § 744.24 all comes from law firms' secondary readings of the rule text; this check could not read the Federal Register text directly clause by clause, and different firms give slightly different effective dates (11/15 or 11/16) and comment-deadline descriptions, so the primary document could diverge in detail. Second, RASA having been 'in motion for nearly a year' says nothing about when, or whether, it clears the Senate or truly gets folded into the NDAA; this check found no concrete Senate schedule, and 'the House already passed it' should not be read as 'Senate passage is just a matter of time' — recent Congresses have no shortage of bipartisan House bills that stalled in the Senate for years without a vote.

items.source: Gibson Dunn、WilmerHale、Morgan Lewis、Wiley、Squire Patton Boggs、Pillsbury等法律事務所快訊；govinfo.gov國會記錄

title.zh: Counterpoint Research：Q3記憶體產業營收年增近5倍，三星以38%市佔居冠、SK海力士季增逾40%緊追，三大廠2026年HBM與DRAM產能近乎售罄、2027年價格看漲
title.en: Counterpoint Research: Q3 Memory-Industry Revenue Up Nearly 5x YoY, Samsung Leads With 38% Share as SK Hynix Closes In With 40%+ QoQ Growth, All Three Majors' 2026 HBM/DRAM Capacity Nearly Sold Out, 2027 Prices Expected to Keep Rising

summary.zh: 市場研究機構Counterpoint Research發布的《Global Memory Tracker》Q3 2026數據顯示：DRAM市佔三星以38%居冠、SK海力士29%居次、Micron 21%、中國CXMT 9%；SK海力士單季營收季增逾40%、追趕速度為三大廠中最快，整體DRAM產業Q3營收年增近5倍、單季規模逼近2,000億美元量級。HBM方面，Counterpoint另指出SK海力士在HBM3E世代持續居於主導地位，但成長動能放緩，三星的HBM4則獲得客戶端正面採用、被預期可能在2027年奪下HBM市場龍頭位置。三大廠2026全年HBM與DRAM產能據報已近乎全數售罄，Counterpoint預期2027年記憶體價格仍將維持高檔甚至續漲，原因是新產能要等到2028年才會量產上線。
summary.en: Market research firm Counterpoint Research's Global Memory Tracker for Q3 2026 shows DRAM market share led by Samsung at 38%, SK Hynix second at 29%, Micron at 21%, and China's CXMT at 9%; SK Hynix's quarterly revenue grew over 40% QoQ, the fastest catch-up pace among the three majors, with the overall DRAM industry's Q3 revenue up nearly 5x year-over-year, approaching a roughly $200B quarterly scale. On HBM, Counterpoint separately notes SK Hynix remains dominant in the HBM3E generation but its growth momentum is slowing, while Samsung's HBM4 is gaining positive customer adoption and is expected to potentially take the HBM market lead in 2027. All three majors' 2026 HBM and DRAM capacity is reportedly nearly sold out, and Counterpoint expects 2027 memory prices to stay elevated or keep rising, since new capacity won't reach volume production until 2028.

implication.zh: 本站9/14週報當時把HBM管制定性為「沒有擋住中國做AI晶片，而是把自主路線變成一項稅，稅率由2026年記憶體超級循環決定」；本期Counterpoint的Q3數據給了這個框架具體的量化佐證——營收年增近5倍、全年產能近乎售罄，意味著這個「稅率」在過去一季持續走高，而且看不到2027年會降溫的跡象(新產能要等到2028年才上線)。對你的台股量化模型而言，記憶體供給吃緊這件事本身已經不是單純的半導體景氣循環敘事，而是與11/20報告、本期BIS遠端存取規則補完所記錄的AI晶片出口管制體制形成共振：運算力(GPU/先進邏輯晶片)被出口管制卡住的同時，記憶體(HBM/DRAM)這個運算力的互補資源，因為產能本身結構性不足而漲價——兩種稀缺性疊加在同一套AI供應鏈上，會讓任何單純用「出口管制鬆緊」來預測中國AI發展速度的模型失真，因為就算管制明天全部解除，記憶體產能瓶頸也不會在2028年之前消失。
implication.en: This site's 9/14 weekly framed HBM controls as not stopping China from building AI chips but turning self-reliance into a tax, with the rate set by the 2026 memory supercycle; this period's Counterpoint Q3 data gives that framework concrete quantitative backing — revenue up nearly 5x and annual capacity nearly sold out, meaning that 'tax rate' kept climbing over the past quarter with no sign of cooling in 2027 (new capacity doesn't arrive until 2028). For your Taiwan-equities quant model, tight memory supply is no longer just a semiconductor-cycle story — it resonates with the AI-chip export-control regime the 11/20 report and this period's BIS rule update both log: compute (GPUs/advanced logic chips) is choked by export controls at the same time memory (HBM/DRAM) — compute's complementary resource — is rising in price from its own structural capacity shortfall. Two kinds of scarcity stacking on the same AI supply chain will distort any model that tries to predict China's AI-development pace purely from export-control tightness or looseness, because even if controls were lifted entirely tomorrow, the memory capacity bottleneck would not disappear before 2028.

counterpoint.zh: Counterpoint自身數據在不同報導間已出現小幅落差(例如Q2市佔在不同轉述中分別給出SK海力士25%與26%兩種數字)，顯示這類市場追蹤報告本身帶有估算誤差，不應把單季百分點差異當成精確值看待。另外，「2027年價格續漲」是Counterpoint的預測而非已發生的事實，BofA等機構雖引用TrendForce給出類似看漲預期，但也同時示警若總體景氣在2027年提前降溫，記憶體價格可能比預期更早回落，不應把當前的「近乎售罄」直接外推成「稀缺性會持續到2028年」這麼長的時間。
counterpoint.en: Counterpoint's own figures show minor discrepancies across different relays (for instance, Q2 share is given as either 25% or 26% for SK Hynix in different accounts), indicating this class of market-tracking report carries its own estimation error and quarterly percentage-point differences shouldn't be treated as precise. Separately, '2027 prices keep rising' is Counterpoint's forecast, not an observed fact; while BofA and others cite similar bullish expectations from TrendForce, they also warn that if the broader economic cycle cools earlier than expected in 2027, memory prices could fall back sooner than projected — the current 'near sold-out' state shouldn't be extrapolated into scarcity lasting all the way to 2028.

items.source: Counterpoint Research《Global Memory Tracker》（經GamesBeat、MobileWorldLive、EE Times Japan等轉述）

title.zh: 同一週，AI治理在兩個層次走向完全相反的速度：CCW日內瓦大會把自主武器「怎麼用」的國際規則擱置到至少2028年，BIS卻在幾天內就把AI晶片「誰能遠端用」的管制體制整套換掉——能被一國單邊決定的層次管得動，需要對手同意的層次管不動
title.en: Same Week, AI Governance Moves at Opposite Speeds on Two Layers: CCW's Geneva Conference Shelves International Rules on How Autonomous Weapons May Be Used Until at Least 2028, While BIS Swaps Out the Entire Regime Governing Who May Remotely Use AI Chips Within Days — What One State Can Decide Unilaterally Gets Governed; What Needs an Adversary's Consent Does Not

summary.zh: 本期兩條獨立訊號放在一起看，拼出一個比任一條單獨成立時更鋒利的對比。第一條，CCW《特定常規武器公約》第七次審查大會11/16-20在日內瓦召開，結果是與會國只同意「繼續討論」自主武器系統、目標2028年「精緻化」一份可能的協議，美俄以色列聯手擋下任何具法律約束力的談判授權——這是一條需要對手(俄羅斯、潛在對手陣營)同意才能前進的治理軌道，本期走到了「至少兩年內不會前進」的終局。第二條，美國商務部BIS同樣在11/16發布一份臨時最終規則，不只堵住AI晶片境外資料中心的遠端存取漏洞，還同步正式廢止整套拜登時代的AI Diffusion Rule、把新管制寫入EAR § 744.24——這是一條完全不需要任何對手同意、只靠美國行政部門自己簽字就能生效的治理軌道，從公告到生效只花了幾天。同一週、同一個「AI軍事化與供應鏈」大主題下，兩條治理軌道的推進速度，正好對應它們各自是否需要對手同意這個結構性差異。
summary.en: Two independent items this period, read together, sharpen into a contrast neither supports alone. First, the CCW's Seventh Review Conference ran 11/16-20 in Geneva, ending with states agreeing only to keep discussing autonomous weapons systems, targeting an 'elaborated' accord by 2028, as the US, Russia and Israel jointly blocked any legally binding negotiating mandate — a governance track that needs an adversary's (Russia's, and a bloc of potential adversaries') consent to advance, and which this period reached a terminal 'will not advance for at least two years' state. Second, US Commerce's BIS issued an interim final rule, also on 11/16, that not only closes the AI-chip remote-access loophole at overseas data centers but simultaneously formally rescinds the entire Biden-era AI Diffusion Rule and writes the new control into EAR § 744.24 — a governance track that needs no adversary's consent at all, taking effect purely on the US executive branch's own signature, within days of announcement. In the same week, under the same broad 'AI militarization and supply chain' umbrella, how fast each governance track moved tracked exactly whether it structurally required an adversary's consent.

implication.zh: 這個對比給你一個可以直接複述、且經得起追問的分析框架：評估任何「AI治理」議題的實際進度，第一個該問的問題不是「這件事有多重要」，而是「推動這件事需不需要對手點頭」。CCW需要俄羅斯、美國彼此都同意才能啟動談判，結果就是連談判本身都沒有被授權；BIS的遠端存取規則只需要美國商務部自己簽字，結果就是從11/16公告到寫入EAR條文幾乎是同步發生，中國商務部截至查核時點也只能用口頭揚言反制、沒有對等的單邊工具可以同樣快速地回敬。11/9週報當時的結論「規範寫在平台上、自主性卻是一次軟體更新」，本期可以再往前推一步：不只是自主性的治理軌道被供應鏈的治理軌道追著跑，而是這兩條軌道從結構上就不是同一個速度的競賽——國際法層次的AI治理，天生受制於共識決這個最慢的分母；單邊出口管制層次的AI治理，天生只受制於行政部門自己的意志。對你跟各國高階官員對談時，這代表一件操作上重要的事：任何關於「全球該如何治理AI」的討論，如果混用這兩個層次的進度來評估整體樂觀或悲觀程度，會得到一個自相矛盾的畫面——而這正是因為它們根本不是同一種治理機制，不該被放在同一條時間軸上比較速度。
implication.en: This contrast gives you an analytical frame you can repeat and defend under questioning: the first question in assessing any 'AI governance' topic's real progress isn't how important it is, but whether advancing it needs an adversary's nod. CCW needed both Russia and the US to agree before negotiations could even launch, and the result is that the negotiation itself was never authorized; BIS's remote-access rule needed only Commerce's own signature, and the result is that the announcement on 11/16 and its codification into EAR text happened almost simultaneously, with China's Commerce Ministry, as of this check, left with only a verbal threat and no unilateral tool of its own to answer just as fast. The 11/9 weekly's conclusion — 'the rules are written on platforms; autonomy ships as a software update' — can be pushed one step further this period: it's not just that the autonomy-governance track is being outrun by the supply-chain-governance track; the two tracks were never running the same race to begin with. AI governance at the level of international law is structurally bound by consensus, its slowest common denominator; AI governance at the level of unilateral export control is bound only by one executive branch's own will. For a senior conversation, this matters operationally: any discussion of 'how should the world govern AI' that blends progress from these two levels into one overall optimism-or-pessimism read will produce a self-contradictory picture — precisely because they were never the same governance mechanism, and shouldn't be compared on the same timeline for speed.

counterpoint.zh: 這個對比可能過度工整。第一，CCW與BIS規則的時程重疊很可能只是巧合——CCW審查大會每五年固定召開一次、日期早在數年前就已排定，BIS的規則研擬也通常走自己的行政程序時程，兩者11/16撞期沒有任何證據顯示是刻意安排，不應過度解讀成某種「同週對照」的敘事設計。第二，「單邊治理永遠比多邊治理快」這個推論本身也有反例——BIS這次能快速立規，部分正是因為國會的RASA法案已經醞釀將近一年打下政治基礎，不是純粹的「行政部門一聲令下」；如果沒有國會這一年的鋪墊，BIS規則是否還能這麼快落地，查核範圍內無法驗證，不應把這個案例過度一般化成「單邊治理永遠比多邊治理有效率」的普遍規律。
counterpoint.en: This contrast may be too neat. First, the CCW and BIS rules' timing overlap is quite plausibly coincidental — the CCW Review Conference is fixed every five years with dates set years in advance, and BIS rulemaking typically follows its own administrative timeline; nothing indicates the 11/16 overlap was deliberate, and it shouldn't be over-read as some designed 'same-week contrast' narrative. Second, the inference that 'unilateral governance is always faster than multilateral governance' has its own counter-case: BIS could move this fast partly because Congress's RASA bill had already spent nearly a year building the political groundwork — not purely 'the executive branch issuing an order.' Whether BIS's rule could have landed this quickly without that year of congressional groundwork can't be verified within this check's reach, and this case shouldn't be over-generalized into a universal rule that unilateral governance is always more efficient than multilateral governance.
